GamificationPalier.label: Paliers de Gamification
GamificationPalier.schema: CREATE TABLE gamification_paliers (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100), points_required INT, badge_name VARCHAR(100), badge_icon VARCHAR(50), badge_color VARCHAR(20))

GamificationTransaction.label: Historique des points
GamificationTransaction.schema: CREATE TABLE gamification_transactions (id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, points INT, reason VARCHAR(100), metadata TEXT, date DATETIME)
